items.question: What is No Barriers, No Excuses?
items.answer: A movement inside triathlon, started by Europe Triathlon's Women's Committee. Volunteers, coaches, officials and federation people trying to make the sport fairer to get into, and to stay in.

items.question: Is this only for people who have faced discrimination?
items.answer: No. If you care about who gets to take part in triathlon, come.

items.question: Will there be a recording?
items.answer: Yes. Register and we'll send it to you, even if you can't make it live.

items.question: What is the roundtable?
items.answer: A smaller follow-up on Tuesday 24 November at 13:00 CET, with breakout rooms and time to swap contacts. You opt in on the registration form.
